lines.ja: 東京都の西のはし、梨ヶ坂市。
lines.en: Nashigasaka City, out on the western edge of Tokyo.

lines.ja: 名物は、梨と坂。
lines.en: Famous for two things: pears and hills.

lines.ja: この坂、毎朝むりぃ〜ッ！
lines.en: This hill. Every. Single. Morning. I can't!!

lines.ja: 幸水、今が食べごろだよ！
lines.en: Kosui pears — ripe and ready right now!

lines.ja: その坂の上の市役所の、さらに地下――
lines.en: At the top of that hill stands City Hall. And one floor below it—

lines.ja: 梨ヶ坂市役所・特務トレンド係。
lines.en: Nashigasaka City Hall. The Special Trends Unit.

lines.ja: 世の流行を行政に活かす係――ということになっている。
lines.en: A unit that puts the latest trends to work for the public. Officially, anyway.

lines.ja: 今日は四時間……千百二十円
lines.en: Four hours today... 1,120 yen.

lines.ja: ふわあ〜あ……おい小僧！　今日は何がバズってる？
lines.en: Haaaaah... Oi, kid! What's blowing up today?

lines.ja: 知りません。時給に入ってないので
lines.en: No idea. That's not what I'm paid for.

lines.ja: この苦情と、この職員。地下で頼むよ
lines.en: This complaint, and this employee. Both go to the basement.

lines.ja: 同じ朝、本庁の部長室。
lines.en: That same morning, in the director's office at the main building.
lines.note: “The main building” is City Hall proper, where the career track lives. The basement is where careers go to be forgotten.

lines.ja: ……承知いたしました
lines.en: ...Understood, sir.

lines.ja: また、問題が増えそうだ……
lines.en: More trouble headed my way...

lines.ja: 源田くん、鈴木くん。本日から、仲間が一人増えます
lines.en: Genda. Suzuki. As of today, the unit gains one member.

lines.ja: ……時給は増えますか
lines.en: ...Does my hourly rate gain anything?

lines.ja: 本日付で着任しました。企画課から参りました、赤嶺レナです
lines.en: Reporting as of today. Rena Akamine, transferred from Policy Planning.

lines.ja: な、なんで私が、こんなところで……！？
lines.en: W-why am I stuck in a place like this...?!

lines.ja: 正しいことを、正しい場所で言いすぎた
lines.en: She said the right thing, in the right place, one time too many.

lines.ja: テツ、まさか、あなたの係だったなんて
lines.en: Tetsu. Don't tell me this is your unit.

lines.ja: おう、赤嶺か！　ここは世の流行を行政に活かす、特務トレンド係だッ！
lines.en: Well, if it isn't Akamine! This is the Special Trends Unit — where trends serve the public!

lines.ja: なにもしてません
lines.en: We do nothing here.

lines.ja: 本庁から回ってきた案件です。市民体育館の予約が、半年前から一枠も取れないと
lines.en: It came down from the main building. Nobody has managed to book a single slot at the civic gym in six months.

lines.ja: これを解決すれば、私は本庁に……ッ！　ゴホン！　市民のために解決します
lines.en: Solve this, and I'm back at the main building—! Ahem. I will solve it for the citizens.

lines.ja: ゴホンじゃねえよ！　企画課から地下に落ちてきた奴が、手ぶらで上に戻れるかっての
lines.en: Don't you 'ahem' me! You dropped from Planning to the basement. Nobody climbs back up empty-handed.

lines.ja: ……部長の条件です！　半年だれも片付けられなかったこの苦情を解決できたら、本庁に戻すと……！
lines.en: ...It's the director's deal! Clear the complaint nobody could clear in six months, and he sends me back...!

lines.ja: ぶはははッ！　片付かない苦情と、うるさい職員を、まとめて地下に捨てたってわけだ！
lines.en: Bwahahaha! So he dumped the complaint he couldn't fix and the employee he couldn't shut up into the same basement!

lines.ja: 解決できなかったら、ずっとここの人ですね
lines.en: And if you don't fix it, you live down here forever.

lines.ja: 少年野球、ママさんバレー、太極拳の老人会……どいつもこいつも、来月の練習場所が無くて困ってやがる……！
lines.en: Little League, the moms' volleyball team, the seniors' tai chi club... not one of them has anywhere to practice next month...!

lines.ja: 取れない、ってことは……欲しがってる奴がいるってことだよなァ？　ぐふっ、ぐふふふ
lines.en: Nobody can get a slot... which means everybody wants one. Doesn't it? Heh. Heh heh heh.

lines.ja: 使用料は一枠せいぜい千円。困ってる連中は三千円でも払う。差額二千円、百枠押さえりゃ……
lines.en: A slot costs 1,000 yen, tops. People this desperate would pay 3,000. That's 2,000 a slot — grab a hundred slots and...

lines.ja: 二十万だァーッ！！
lines.en: TWO HUNDRED THOUSAND YEN!!

lines.ja: 転売する気なのッ！？
lines.en: You're going to scalp them?!

lines.ja: 人聞きの悪い〜。『譲渡』だよ、『譲渡』
lines.en: Such an ugly word. It's a “transfer.” A transfer.

lines.ja: ……なるほどな。仕組みが分かれば、こんなもんは……チョロいッ！
lines.en: ...I see. Once you know how the system works, this is... easy money!

lines.ja: 枠は毎月一日の零時に一斉に開く。早い者勝ちだ。……で、一団体につき一日三枠まで
lines.en: Every slot opens at midnight on the 1st. First come, first served. ...And it's three slots a day per group.
lines.note: Japanese public gyms are usually booked through a city reservation site that opens all slots at the same moment — hence the midnight rush.

lines.ja: 毎月1日 深夜0時
lines.en: 1st of the month, midnight

lines.ja: 翌々月分を一斉開放
lines.en: Slots for the month after next, all released at once

lines.ja: 先着順
lines.en: First come, first served

lines.ja: 1団体あたり 1日3枠まで
lines.en: Up to 3 slots a day per group

lines.ja: 上限は“一団体につき”だ……なら、団体を増やせばいいッ！
lines.en: The cap is per GROUP... so we just make more groups!

lines.ja: 零時に叩き起こすッ！　一枠押さえるごとに五百円だァ！
lines.en: I'm dragging you out of bed at midnight! 500 yen for every slot you grab!

lines.ja: 無理です。十八歳未満は夜十時から朝五時まで働かせちゃいけないんですよ。労働基準法六十一条
lines.en: Can't. Under-18s aren't allowed to work between 10 p.m. and 5 a.m. Labor Standards Act, Article 61.
lines.note: Real law: Japan's Labor Standards Act bars anyone under 18 from working between 10 p.m. and 5 a.m.

lines.ja: なら仕事じゃねえ！　〝趣味〟で、家から押せ。お小遣いだ！
lines.en: Then it isn't work! Tap away at home — as a “hobby.” Call it pocket money!

lines.ja: ……趣味なら、やります
lines.en: ...If it's a hobby, I'm in.

lines.ja: ぬおおおおおおおッ！！
lines.en: NGOOOOOOOOH!!

lines.ja: カチカチカチカチ
lines.en: tap tap tap tap

lines.ja: 趣味、趣味、趣味……
lines.en: Hobby. Hobby. Hobby...

lines.ja: ドドドドド
lines.en: R U M B L E

lines.ja: は、八十七枠……ッ！
lines.en: E-eighty-seven slots...!

lines.ja: 来月の体育館は、全部おれのもんだァーッ！！
lines.en: Next month, that gym is ALL MINE!!

lines.ja: ザワザワ
lines.en: murmur murmur

lines.ja: 来月、体育館が一枠も取れないんですけどォ！？
lines.en: We can't book one single slot at the gym next month!

lines.ja: 子どもらの練習は、どうすりゃいいんですかーッ！！
lines.en: Where are our kids supposed to practice?!

lines.ja: 源田、源田、源田、源田……
lines.en: Genda. Genda. Genda. Genda...

lines.ja: テツ！！！
lines.en: TETSU!!!

lines.ja: おっ客か？
lines.en: Oh? Customers?

lines.ja: 源田さん。少々、お時間よろしいでしょうか
lines.en: Mr. Genda. Might I have a moment of your time?
lines.note: In Japanese he switches from the casual “Genda-kun” to the formal “Genda-san.” When this boss gets polite, someone is in serious trouble.

lines.ja: 市の設備は、市民のものです
lines.en: City facilities belong to the citizens.

lines.ja: あ、あわわわ……
lines.en: A-ah— aaah...

lines.ja: 秒で取れたのですから、秒で返せますね
lines.en: You took them in seconds. So you can give them back in seconds.

lines.ja: じゅ、じゅ、十秒ォォーッ！？
lines.en: T-t-ten seconds?!

lines.ja: 上限が“一団体あたり”では意味がありませんッ！　次回から抽選にすべきです！
lines.en: A cap “per group” is meaningless! From next month it has to be a lottery!

lines.ja: 助かりましたぁ〜！　問い合わせたら十秒で返事が来て……！
lines.en: You saved us! I asked about it and had an answer in ten seconds!

lines.ja: で、僕の歩合は
lines.en: So. My commission.

lines.ja: ゼロだッ！！　全額返金したんだよォ！！
lines.en: ZERO!! I refunded every last yen!!

lines.ja: ……解決は、した
lines.en: ...It is, however, resolved.

lines.ja: 源田くん。十一秒でしたね。始末書を、もう一枚
lines.en: Genda. That took eleven seconds. One more letter of apology, please.
lines.note: A shimatsusho is a written apology filed with your employer — a small, very real black mark on your record.

lines.ja: ひィィィィ〜〜ッ！！
lines.en: Hiiiiiiii—!!
